R13 adaptation notes (not source code):

1. Represent remaining floor capacity as usable regions after placed footprints and margins have been subtracted.
2. Derive candidate rectangles from remaining geometry; absence of a rectangle is a normal, explicit placement failure.
3. Select a starting pose from a reachable remaining region, using its interior rather than a fixed scene origin.
4. Quantize candidate evidence only after the geometric query so deterministic output does not replace physical validation.

R13 uses these ideas only to define floor anchors, clearance and connected components. It does not copy ProcTHOR sampling, randomization, Unity/AI2-THOR integration or Python code.
